name: Emmforce Auto.
why: Profit breakout: +100% YoY and above the last 4 quarters
Management outlook: So we are now going to our customers for a price revision and with that, we expect our standalone margins to come back to the 20%
Latest quarter Sep 2026: Excellent (sales +163% YoY, profit +100% YoY)
Cost quality excellent: costs falling, margin expanding, operating profit growing (costs 86% to 83% of sales)
Vendor-qualification / long-term-agreement language on the concall
risks: Working capital stretching - debtor days 116 to 109, inventory days 96 to 140 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Micro cap (Rs 307 Cr): thin trading, higher risk - keep the position small
Weak cash conversion: operating cash flow only -120% of 3-year profit
Sector cycle: Earnings at peak but price weakening (late-cycle risk)

guidance: So we are now going to our customers for a price revision and with that, we expect our standalone margins to come back to the 20% to 22% range.
We expect the first order from them in January '27, once their testing is complete.
capex: We spent only INR3 crores on capex in H1 against INR18 crores in the same period last year.
So we now have an installed capacity of about INR350 crores.
risks: For Emmforce Mobility, because of the delay at TAFE and expected slowdown in the agri market in the coming months due to the monsoon which has been staggered, we are bringing our estimate down to about INR20 crores this
And I think even in Emmbros we were facing some challenges on the capacity front and we were planning to utilize Emmforce's vacant space in the current setup.
focus: But now it seems that we are again going back to focusing on our own brand, which I think is extremely time- consuming and difficult to crack given how competitive the market is.
We are targeting INR40 crores sales, so INR40 crores sales here I'm assuming will be including the forging sales that we do to our parent.
That's what we are targeting, that we should do about INR40 crores.

customers.name: Mahindra
customers.ctx: Earlier, we were thinking of launching our own brand and focusing more there, then again we were talking about selling or doing contract manufacturing for some of the larger players like TAFE and Mahindra.

quals: The PPAP samples are with the customer, and we expect production to start next quarter.
People are now trying in, getting in, and repeat orders will start coming in.
And then, the other business because of our own brand business will also have repeat orders and our new segments will also open up.
